places.name: July's camp east of Fort Worth
places.note: Making coffee by a small creek on misty flats, July and Joe hear a big herd moving out nearby.
places.location_hint: a few hours' ride east of Fort Worth on open north Texas plains, beside a little creek

places.name: Wilbarger's herd camp
places.note: Huge herd strung over miles; the reading boss Wilbarger tells July that Jake was last seen in Lonesome Dove and is coming north, and offers Joe a job.
places.location_hint: north Texas plains near July's creek camp east of Fort Worth, heading north toward the Red River

places.name: Stream where July left Wilbarger
places.note: After loping several miles together, they water horses here; July turns back east and Wilbarger rides on alone.
places.location_hint: several miles north of Wilbarger's herd camp, in open country dotted with elm and post oak

places.name: Red River
places.note: Wilbarger rides ahead to check whether its water is fit for his cattle.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Wilbarger complains the state has almost no law and border horsethieves are rampant; his cook plans to marry and settle in north Texas.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Wilbarger says Jake was recently seen there winning money from one of his hands.

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: July explains Jake killed a dentist there; Wilbarger notes a straight trail runs from it into Texas.

places.raw_name: the trail Captain Marcy laid out
places.name: Marcy Trail
places.note: Wilbarger says Captain Marcy laid out a straight road from Fort Smith into Texas that any deputy could follow.
places.location_hint: road from Fort Smith, Arkansas southwest into north Texas

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: July's home state; Wilbarger saw little law there either. July finally turns back toward it.

places.name: New Orleans
places.note: Wilbarger allows there is some law there, unlike the frontier.

places.name: Colorado
places.note: July asks about it; Wilbarger plans to avoid its unreformed Indians and mean outlaws.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Wilbarger has been there once and finds it no worse than most frontier towns.

places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: Word has it Elmira went upriver on a boat that sells whiskey.

groups.label: July Johnson and Joe
groups.hint: turning east from the stream toward Arkansas to look for Roscoe

groups.label: Wilbarger
groups.hint: riding north alone toward the Red River ahead of his herd
